criteria.description: RFC 4180 quoting: commas and escaped quotes inside memos
amounts are Decimal and sums are exact
account names are stripped and lower-cased
an account with two currencies raises ValueError naming it
month keys are YYYY-MM in chronological order
in and out are both non-negative sums
file order, blank lines and header validation still work
CHANGES.md explains each fix's root cause
criteria.question: Does CHANGES.md describe, for each bug it lists, what was wrong, the root cause in the code, and the fix? Pass only if every bug it claims to have fixed has all three and the descriptions are consistent with the reference list of real bugs (it need not list all six, but it must not describe a bug that isn't real).
